header.title: SlideTransition
header.description: Slide enter/exit from an edge (`from`, or `axis`: `x` → left / `y` → bottom). `fade` (default true) pairs opacity with the transform; set `fade={false}` for translate only. Toggle `isIn`; the node stays mounted until the exit transform ends.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props, toggle slide in/out, and watch the generated code. Enter uses `enter` timing and exit uses `exit`.
playground.label: Slide panel

base.title: Base
base.description: With the defaults (`from="bottom"`, `fade`, `offset="1rem"`, `duration={300}`) the panel slides and fades. After exit it unmounts, unless `keepMounted`.

fromTop.title: From top
fromTop.description: Enters from the top edge. Starts hidden; tap Slide in to play it.

fromBottom.title: From bottom
fromBottom.description: Enters from the bottom edge — typical for a sheet or toast.

fromLeft.title: From left
fromLeft.description: Enters from the left with `offset="2rem"` — typical for a drawer.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: `duration`, `delay`, and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`. Enter is slower with a delay; exit is short.

noFade.title: fade false
noFade.description: `fade={false}` keeps opacity at 1 — only `transform` runs. Use a larger `offset` (here `110%`) so the panel clears the clipped stage before unmount; a small offset looks like a nudge then a pop.

axis.title: axis x
axis.description: `axis="x"` is a shortcut for `from="left"`. `axis="y"` maps to `bottom`. Explicit `from` wins when both are set.

keepMounted.title: keepMounted
keepMounted.description: With `keepMounted`, exit hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Re-enter restores the same DOM node.

initial.title: initial false
initial.description: `initial={false}` skips motion on the first mount (snaps in). Later toggles still slide. Use Remount to see the skip again.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the host snaps to the target state with no interpolation.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, slide classes merge onto the single child (no extra wrapper).

texts.title: Drawer
texts.body: Slotted host — the slide runs on the Card.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames.root`. This demo applies `gemst-relative` and `gemst-overflow-hidden`.

header.title: SlideTransition API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `SlideTransition`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for edges, fade, axis, and keepMounted.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/slide-transition` with its `slide-transition.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's, and if both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally (to detect the end of transform) and then calls yours.

items.presence: This is a presence transition: the control that toggles isIn should reflect state. Do not convey information with the slide alone.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final state. The preference is read each render; it is not live-listened.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion on the root. Use only when motion is essential.
items.fade: With fade={false} only translate runs — use a larger offset or clip the host so exit clears the visible area before unmount.
items.keepMounted: With keepMounted the node stays in the DOM with display: none after exit. It should not receive focus or be announced while hidden.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, dialog, div): that element is the slide host.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `inline-flex`; transitions `opacity` (when fade) and `transform`.
items.fade: Opacity animates with the transform. Default.
items.prep: Enter priming: no transition so the resting state cannot flash.
items.keepMountedHidden: Host hidden after exit with `keepMounted` (`display: none`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render (`0ms` when `isDisabled`, reduced motion, or keep-mounted hidden).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase. Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Easing of the current phase. Default `standard`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-slide-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline — use `easing` to change it.

content.title: Content
content.description: What slides and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Edge, fade, distance, and how it stays mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies on slide in and `exit` on slide out.

items.children: Content that slides in and out.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child (no extra wrapper).
items.isIn: `true` slides in and stays mounted; `false` slides out and unmounts after the transition (unless `keepMounted`).
items.from: Edge the content slides from on enter (and toward on exit). Wins over `axis`. Default `bottom` (or from `axis`).
items.axis: Short alternative to `from`: `x` → `left`, `y` → `bottom`. Ignored when `from` is set.
items.fade: `false` only translates (no opacity fade). Default `true`. Without fade, use a larger `offset` or clip the host.
items.offset: Slide distance. Number → pixels; string → CSS length. Default `1rem`.
items.keepMounted: After exit, hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.unmountOnExit: Unmounts immediately on exit (skips the exit slide).
items.initial: `false` skips motion on the first mount. Later toggles still animate. Default `true`.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is slide in and `exit` is slide out.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onSlide: Fires when the slide is active (`isIn` true).
items.outSlide: Fires on exit (`isIn` false), disable, or unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-slide-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
